item.title: Talk to Talk
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Clear
  • 発売日: 2002-02-01
  • スコア: 6.44/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: TALK to TALK
  • 英語名: Talk to Talk

あらすじ

The protagonist is an artificial life form created with the best of cloning technology and genetic engineering. As a result, he has no feelings of joy, anger, sorrow or pleasure. It was a certain school that became the place for his emotional development experiments. Hiding his true identity, he gradually becomes friends with five girls at the school.
